errors.evidence: The description claims the y-axis is labeled with "честота" (frequency), but there is no label on the y-axis in the image.
The description states the value for the first bar ("разходи") is around thirty-two, but the bar is clearly below the 30 line, at approximately 29.
The description states the value for the second bar ("качество") is around fifteen, but the bar is clearly below the 15 line, at approximately 14.
The description states the value for the fourth bar ("местоположение") is approximately eight, but the bar is visibly lower, at approximately 7.

errors.text_span: Няма визуални отличителни белези, показващи подреждане по отношение на размер или важност на честотата.
errors.evidence: The description explicitly and incorrectly states that there is no ordering by size, when the bars are clearly sorted in descending order of value from left to right.
The phrase "която гледа надолу" (which looks down) is an awkward and unclear way to describe the vertical orientation of the y-axis.
